title: Principles of Real Estate - Michigan Salesperson Prelicensure

operational_policy.basis: StateCourse provider proposal pending PSS review; not a Michigan-prescribed ratio

_completion_rules_notes.final_exam_required_by_state: MCL 339.2504 and the operative prelicensure-education rules do not prescribe a final examination. R 339.22154(2)(c) records a grade only 'if an examination is required to determine successful completion'. The Michigan submission draft includes module assessments and remediation but no separate provider final. No Michigan document may describe a final examination as a state requirement. Any later final would require a documented threshold, secure bank, grade-retention rule, and change-control review.
_completion_rules_notes.proctoring_required_by_state: Michigan's identity requirement attaches to certificate issuance and to the accuracy of reported attendance (R 339.22154(5)), not to supervised examination. California's proctor rule is not imported.
_completion_rules_notes.student_record_retention: R 339.22154(1) requires the record to be permanently maintained. Michigan records are never aged out.
_completion_rules_notes.course_approval_term: R 339.22143(1) expires approval one calendar year after the approval date; the agency-assigned expiration date controls, including across leap years. Renewal is filed not less than 60 days before expiry under R 339.22143(3).
_completion_rules_notes.noneducational_solicitation_during_credi: R 339.22159 prohibits organizational-membership, employment, business-related, and other noneducational presentations or solicitations during a prelicensure course and denies clock-hour credit for them. Marketing, account upgrades, recruiting, and noncredit offers stay outside the 40 credited hours.

rule_numbering_note: The Real Estate Brokers and Salespersons general rules were renumbered and largely rescinded effective June 4, 2025 (2025 MR 12). Citations here use the current prelicensure-education numbering, R 339.22141 to R 339.22159. LARA's course approval form, rev. 3/23, still cites the superseded Rule 618 and Rule 626.
configuration_scope: Michigan only; no setting is inherited by another state.
